description: Update an existing assignment in a course, changing only the fields you pass — anything omitted keeps its current value — and return the updated assignment object. Calling this again with the same arguments leaves the assignment in the same state, unlike create_assignment, which always makes a new one; use delete_assignment to remove this assignment instead. due_at, lock_at, and unlock_at set here apply to every student without an override; use create_assignment_override for a different date for one section, group, or set of students, or set_student_assignment_dates to fan one student's date change across many assignments at once. lock_at must stay after due_at and unlock_at before due_at when both are set. Requires instructor/TA permission to manage assignments and quizzes in the course.

due_at.description: New due date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-05-01T23:59:00Z)

grade_group_students_individually.description: For group assignments, whether each member is graded separately (false = one shared group grade)

lock_at.description: New date after which the assignment locks and stops accepting submissions, in ISO 8601 format. Must be after due_at when there is one

omit_from_final_grade.description: Whether to leave this assignment out of the final grade calculation

published.description: Whether the assignment is published and visible to students

unlock_at.description: New date the assignment becomes available to students, in ISO 8601 format. Must be before due_at when there is one

name: update_assignment
title: Update Assignment
